request_schema.title: Get Gen2X Configuration Request
request_schema.description: No request body required. Use GET /cloud/impinjGen2X.

response_schema.title: Get Gen2X Configuration Success Response
response_schema.description: Returns the last saved Gen2X feature. Exactly one feature object is present after any successful PUT. If Gen2X has never been configured, REST GET returns an empty body (not JSON {}).

fastID.description: FastID configuration (present only if previously configured)

tagProtect.description: Protected Mode configuration (present only if previously configured)

action.description: Current protection action applied to the tag

password.description: 8-character hexadecimal 32-bit password used for tag protection

tagID.description: Hexadecimal EPC of the protected tag

enableShortRange.description: Whether short-range protection mode is enabled

tagFocus.description: TagFocus configuration (present only if previously configured)

tagQuieting.description: Tag quieting configuration. Provide exactly one of basic or advanced.

action.description: Action applied to the specified tags

tagIDs.description: List of hexadecimal EPC strings of affected tags

advanced.description: Advanced TagQuieting configuration using Impinj Gen2X proprietary features.

preSelect.description: Optional array of SELECT operations to position tags into specific session states before applying the state-aware SELECT. Maximum 31 items allowed.

action.description: Action to perform on the target. For target SL, provide an SL action using ASSERTSL, DEASSERTSL, or NEGATESL. For targets S0, S1, S2, or S3, provide a session action using INVA, INVB, or FLIPAB.

value.description: Hex string value to match (even length, valid hex characters).

tagQuietMasks.description: Session-state combinations to check. Minimum 1, maximum 3 items. No duplicate session prefixes allowed (e.g., S0A and S0B together).

target.description: Which flag to manipulate based on state check.

stateAwareAction.description: Action to perform when tags match the tagQuietMasks pattern. For target SL, provide an SL action using ASSERTSL, DEASSERTSL, or NEGATESL. For targets S0, S1, S2, or S3, provide a session action using INVA, INVB, or FLIPAB.

request_schema.title: Set Radio Performance Request
request_schema.description: Complete operating-mode configuration. The request replaces the current mode instead of merging fields.

modeSpecificSettings.description: Settings used by INVENTORY or PORTAL mode.

interval.description: How often each tag is reported.

startTrigger.description: GPI trigger that starts portal reads.

stopInterval.description: Seconds to continue reading after the last unique tag is read.

antennas.description: Antenna ports used for inventory. If omitted, all ports are used.

filter.description: Includes or excludes tags by EPC prefix, suffix, or regular expression. A prefix filter cannot be used with query or selects.

value.description: Value to match. Prefix and suffix values must contain an even number of hexadecimal characters.

mode.description: Inventory protocol used to communicate with tags.

transmitPower.description: Transmit power in dBm. A single value applies to all antennas; an array supplies one value per antenna.

antennaStopCondition.description: Stop condition applied to all antennas, or one condition per antenna.

value.description: Numeric limit, or a GPI trigger when type is GPI.
Numeric limit or GPI trigger configuration.

query.description: Gen2 query parameters applied to all antennas, or one query object per antenna.

selects.description: Gen2 SELECT operations for all antennas, or a nested array containing one SELECT list per antenna.

delayAfterSelects.description: Milliseconds to wait after the final SELECT before issuing a query.

accesses.description: Gen2 access operations for all antennas, or a nested array containing one access list per antenna. Not supported in INVENTORY mode or with reportFilter.

config.description: Fields depend on the access type.

items.description: READ, WRITE, ACCESS, LOCK, or KILL operation.

tagMetaData.description: Additional values included in tag reports.

radioStartConditions.description: Controls when inventory begins after a start command. Not supported in PORTAL mode.

radioStopConditions.description: Controls when an ongoing inventory operation stops. Not supported in PORTAL mode.

durationAfterNoMoreUniqueTags.description: Seconds without a new unique tag before stopping.

reportFilter.description: Controls how frequently a tag is reported. Cannot be used in INVENTORY mode or with accesses.

duration.description: Seconds before the same tag can be reported again.

rssiFilter.description: Ignores tag responses below the configured RSSI threshold.
